p: Iron Brigade crashes into Archer's Confederate brigade in Herbst Woods. Close-range fighting. Archer's right flank overlapped. Archer himself is CAPTURED — first Confederate general taken since Lee assumed command. Private Patrick Maloney, 2nd Wisconsin, personally captured Archer.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Iron Brigade crashes into Archer's Confederate brigade in Herbst Woods.”, Day 1

p: Buford dispatches pickets west and north of Gettysburg along all approach roads. Gamble's brigade occupies McPherson's Ridge. Devin's brigade screens north and east.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Buford dispatches pickets west and north of Gettysburg along all approach roads.”, Day 1

p: Iron Brigade sweeps through Herbst Woods. Archer's brigade broken and fleeing west across Willoughby Run. I Corps establishes defensive line along McPherson's Ridge south of Chambersburg Pike.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Iron Brigade sweeps through Herbst Woods.”, Day 1

p: North of the pike, Davis's Confederate brigade advances in three regiments. Cutler's Union brigade rushes to deploy north of Chambersburg Pike. Hall's battery (2nd Maine) unlimbers in the Railroad Cut area.

p.short: Site chronology entry “North of the pike, Davis's Confederate brigade advances in three regiments.”, Day 1

p: Davis's brigade overlaps Cutler's right flank. 76th NY and 56th PA take heavy fire and are forced back. 147th NY stands alone briefly. Meredith wounded — Robinson assumes Iron Brigade command.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Davis's brigade overlaps Cutler's right flank.”, Day 1

p: Davis's brigade pursues Cutler north. 2nd Mississippi and 42nd Mississippi enter the unfinished Railroad Cut west of the pike. Hall's battery forced to withdraw under Confederate pressure.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Davis's brigade pursues Cutler north.”, Day 1

p: 6th Wisconsin (Dawes) detached from Iron Brigade and ordered north across the pike. Joins 14th Brooklyn and 95th NY. Dawes orders charge directly at the Railroad Cut.

p.short: Site chronology entry “6th Wisconsin (Dawes) detached from Iron Brigade and ordered north across the pike.”, Day 1

p: 6th Wisconsin reaches the cut. Davis's Confederates trapped — the cut at the middle position is 15 feet deep and impossible to climb under fire. Mass surrender. Dawes demands surrender: 'Where is the colonel of this regiment?' 232 Confederates captured.

p.short: Site chronology entry “6th Wisconsin reaches the cut.”, Day 1

p: Noon lull begins. Both sides reorganize. Confederate Heth, finding the resistance much heavier than expected, halts and waits for Rodes and Early to arrive from the north. Reynolds replacement confirmed as Doubleday.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Noon lull begins.”, Day 1

p: The 'noon lull' lasted roughly 10:30am-1:00pm. Both sides used the pause to bring up reinforcements and reorganize.

p.author_line: Ask the Historian site records (chronology commentary)
p.short: Site chronology commentary on “Noon lull begins.”, Day 1

p: I Corps completing deployment on McPherson's Ridge and Seminary Ridge. Robinson's division (2nd Division) arrives and takes position on Oak Ridge north of the pike. Buford's cavalry screens the flanks.

p.short: Site chronology entry “I Corps completing deployment on McPherson's Ridge and Seminary Ridge.”, Day 1

p: Rodes's Confederate division (Second Corps) arrives on Oak Hill north of Gettysburg. Rodes sees the Union I Corps position from Oak Hill. Recognizes he can attack the I Corps right flank. Begins deploying.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Rodes's Confederate division (Second Corps) arrives on Oak Hill north of Gettysburg.”, Day 1

p: Rodes's arrival at Oak Hill was an accidental tactical gift — he could see the exposed Union right flank from the hill.

p.author_line: Ask the Historian site records (chronology commentary)
p.short: Site chronology commentary on “Rodes's Confederate division (Second Corps) arrives on Oak Hill north of Gettysburg.”, Day 1

p: Confederate artillery (Jones's and Andrews's battalions) deploys on Oak Hill. Carrington's and Carter's batteries open fire on Union I Corps from an enfilading position — devastating flanking fire.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Confederate artillery (Jones's and Andrews's battalions) deploys on Oak Hill.”, Day 1

p: Heth's lead brigade (Archer) passes through Cashtown and continues east. Davis's brigade in column behind Archer. Pettigrew and Brockenbrough held in reserve at Cashtown.

p.short: Site chronology entry “Heth's lead brigade (Archer) passes through Cashtown and continues east.”, Day 1

p: XI Corps (Howard) begins arriving north of Gettysburg. Howard takes overall command as senior officer. Schurz's division deploys north of town. Barlow's division pushes to Blocher's Knoll (Barlow's Knoll) against Howard's orders.

p.short: Site chronology entry “XI Corps (Howard) begins arriving north of Gettysburg.”, Day 1
